name: goal-orchestrator
description: Ship a goal (an issue and its sub-issues) as one PR on one branch: intake asks which models and effort to use and whether you will be away, then implementer sub-agents work in waves in their own worktrees, reviewer sub-agents check every wave, a final gate and whole-diff review run, and you get the PR, tracker updates and a final report. A built-in watchdog ends the run as DONE, PARTIAL or BLOCKED instead of looping.
